newsitem.title: ESTONIA: VIISNURK HOPES FOR BOURSE LISTING BY MID-JUNE.
newsitem.headline: VIISNURK HOPES FOR BOURSE LISTING BY MID-JUNE.

text.p: Estonian ski producer Viisnurk hopes to be listed on the stock exchange secondary list by mid-June, managing director Meelis Kukk said on Friday.
"Viisnurk has fulfilled the conditions in terms of business size and number of owners," Kukk told Reuters.
"We hope to be listed before St. John's day (June 24)," he added.
"Viisnurk has signed an agreement with Hansa Investments to handle the listing process," he added.
The market capitalisation of a listed stock on the secondary list must be at least 10 million kroons and the company must have at least 100 shareholders.
Ski and furniture producer Viisnurk estimates its profit to be 10 million kroons this year, compared to 8.13 million kroons last year.
The turnover forecast is 185 million kroons, up from 153.9 million kroons last year.
Viisnurk's share capital is 5.37 million kroons. Some 72.6 percent of it belongs to VN Holding, itself owned by the Baltic Republic Fund and the management of Viisnurk.
Other shares are held by 200 small investors.
